name: SendKeys
label: Send Keys
description: Sends keys to the specified target (foreground window, UI element, window handle, or title/class).

fields.name: Target
fields.label: Send Keys To
fields.description: Specifies where to send the keys.

selectOptions.label: Foreground window
selectOptions.description: Sends keys to the currently active window.

selectOptions.label: UI element
selectOptions.description: Sends keys to a specific UI element.

selectOptions.label: Window instance/handle
selectOptions.description: Sends keys to a window by its handle.

selectOptions.label: Title and/or class
selectOptions.description: Sends keys to a window by its title and/or class.

fields.name: UiElement
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element to send keys to (used when 'Send Keys To' is 'UI element').

fields.name: WindowHandle
fields.label: Window Handle
fields.description: The window handle to send keys to (used when 'Send Keys To' is 'Window instance/handle').

fields.name: WindowTitle
fields.label: Window Title
fields.description: The title of the window to send keys to (used when 'Send Keys To' is 'Title and/or class').

fields.name: WindowClass
fields.label: Window Class
fields.description: The class name of the window to send keys to (used when 'Send Keys To' is 'Title and/or class').

fields.name: TextToSend
fields.label: Text to Send
fields.description: The text or special keys to send.

fields.name: DelayBetweenKeystrokes
fields.label: Delay Between Keystrokes
fields.description: Milliseconds to wait between each keystroke.

fields.name: SendAsHardwareKeys
fields.label: Send Text as Hardware Keys
fields.description: If true, sends keys using hardware key codes instead of virtual key codes.
